title: Linked errors
text: Lists every error as a link that moves focus to the field that needs fixing.

title: Announced once
text: A labelled region that takes focus when shown, so screen readers read it once without a live region.

title: Custom focus
text: Items can supply their own focus behavior, such as a component's focus method.

title: Standalone or automatic
text: Form fills it for you, and it also works alone for server-rendered errors.
